column1: # Test-selection map of tools/test_queue.lua (docs/RUNBOOK.md "Dev box: test queue"): path prefix <TAB> what runs beyond the quick suite.
# The first line whose prefix starts the changed path wins; a job's set is the union over its changed files. A path no line matches runs full.
#   none       nothing (a job whose files are all `none` is not even built)
#   @test      the ctest test named like the file: cpp/tests/<t>.cpp -> ^t$
#   @grep      the tests whose cpp/tests/*.cpp mention the file's basename (scenarios, test data)
# Every job runs the quick suite (-LE slow) first and fails fast; the set below adds the selected slow tests (or all of them for full).
